body: Currently this doesn't prevent already connected SDL gamepads from being remapped, this should be fixed/discussed later.
I need to change the way this method works. See also https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_SetGamepadMapping and https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_AddGamepadMapping

Should we deprecate `p_update_existing` parameter since SDL doesn't support it, or should we make changes to our copy of SDL to support it?
But I'm in favor of not adding new features to our copy of SDL, I think we should keep its functionality as close to the original SDL as possible.
I should move this line after `ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG`
